anti_claims.statement: formal dynatomic period is not asserted equal to actual exact period on every special fiber
primitive cover is not asserted everywhere embedded in Spec B_n
normalization is not asserted to commute with a=0 without same-rank and nilpotent-exclusion proof
no every-fiber smooth, reduced, or free-cyclic-torsor claim is made
X_0^aff(n) is not asserted to be a projective compactification
G_global is not asserted to be a subgroup of G_special; the specialization lower-bound direction is corrected
non-base membership alone is not asserted to imply primitivity without the full S_r condition
rho is a pointwise derivative-return trace, not a field trace or the determinant (-a)^n
rank one does not assert that tau or rho lies outside K
no extension to arbitrary generalized Henon maps is asserted
a finite table, numerical roots, or a parameter scan is not treated as proof
scalar rho primitivity, scalar quadratic tau primitivity, and formal trace-spectrum rigidity are not claimed new
